title: Işık Krallığı
author: Nurdan Bağrıaçık
description:
A lonely red lighthouse stands among the waves, proudly believing that its beam is responsible for lighting the world. Night after night, it guides ships safely through the darkness and dreams of illuminating everything around it. But when a fierce storm blocks its light, the lighthouse begins to question its place in the vast universe. An encounter with a wise seagull leads it to a remarkable discovery: There is a much greater source of light above: the Sun. 
Kingdom of Light invites young readers to explore the wonders of nature, astronomy, and perspective.
